description: Henan University maps winter crops in Henan Province for 2019–2021 using fused Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery. A decision tree uses growing-season start, peak timing, end, length and green-up speed to separate overwintering crops from other vegetation. ScienceDB assigns CC BY 4.0 for free reuse, while the inspected metadata leaves the delivered file format and grid resolution unspecified. The maps can locate crop-demand areas in irrigation and food-production simulations. Reported overall classification accuracy is approximately 97.8 percent, but local errors and changing cultivation patterns remain limitations. A crop-area map does not directly provide yields, irrigation withdrawals or supply-chain links. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
